form.title: Title
form.notesPlaceholder: Additional details about scope, deliverables, or anything relevant to the client. Appears on the PDF and public link.
form.termsPlaceholder: e.g. 50% upfront, 50% on delivery. Proposal valid for 30 days. 90-day warranty after completion.
form.validUntilHint: After this date the proposal shows as expired to the client.

pix.title: PIX key for this proposal
pix.hint: Optional. If filled in, this key is used instead of your profile's default PIX key. Useful for random keys with a specific value.
pix.invalid: Invalid PIX key for the selected type

taxId.title: Confirm your tax ID
taxId.description: To create your first proposal on the free plan, we need to confirm your tax ID. It is saved to your profile and won't be asked again.
taxId.hint: We only use the document to prevent multiple free accounts from the same person.
taxId.invalid: Invalid document for the selected type
taxId.duplicate: This CPF/CNPJ is already registered on another account.
taxId.saveError: Could not save the document. Please try again.

extraPages.title: Extra pages
extraPages.hint: Optional. Winning proposals tend to be short — only add these if they help build trust on higher-ticket work.
extraPages.coverHelp: Opening page with your brand, the proposal title, the client and the date.
extraPages.whyMeHelp: Your photo, credential and a short client testimonial (filled in Settings → Branding).

view.sendEmailHelp: Your client receives an email with the proposal link and total. You'll be notified when they open, accept or sign.
view.whatsappPhoneHelp: This client has no phone on file. Enter the number with area code to open the chat with the message ready.
view.whatsappPhoneSave: Save this number to the client record
view.whatsappPhoneSaved: Number saved to the client record

delete.title: Delete proposal?
delete.description: This action cannot be undone. All items and history will be removed.

templates.pickerSubtitle: Pick a ready-made template with sample items, delivery time and validity already suggested. You can edit everything.

simple.title: Simple service
simple.description: A few items. Best for a single one-off service.
simple.proposalDescription: Proposal for the agreed service, with scope, deadline and payment terms defined.
simple.notes:
Delivery deadline: by {{date}}, counted from approval of this proposal.
Anything outside the scope above will be quoted separately.
simple.terms:
This proposal is valid until {{date}}.
Payment: 50% on approval and 50% on delivery.
Changes after approval may affect deadline and price.

phased.title: Project with phases
phased.description: Multiple line items. Best for phased delivery.
phased.proposalDescription: Project split into phases, with deliveries and payments tied to each phase.
phased.notes:
Estimated total: final delivery by {{date}}, counted from approval.
Each phase starts only after the previous one is approved.
phased.terms:
This proposal is valid until {{date}}.
Payment: per completed phase, within 5 days of each delivery.
Up to 2 rounds of revisions per phase are included.

recurring.title: Monthly / retainer package
recurring.proposalDescription: Ongoing service package with a fixed monthly scope and automatic renewal.
recurring.notes:
Expected start: by {{date}}, after approval.
Monthly scope is fixed; extra requests are quoted separately.
recurring.terms:
This proposal is valid until {{date}}.
Payment: monthly fee on the 5th, with automatic renewal.
Cancellation with 30 days notice, no penalty.

send.title: Send proposal
send.description: Choose how to send "{{title}}" to your client.
